picks.file: Gezicht op Arkhangelsk Archangel (titel op object), RP-P-2018-1818.jpg
picks.what: The harbor on the Northern Dvina, wood engraving in a Dutch book (Rijksmuseum)
picks.why: river front with churches, bell tower and ships; title, frame and margins trimmed

picks.file: General view, Archangel, Kola Peninsula, Russia-LCCN2001697444.jpg
picks.what: View across the Northern Dvina, photochrom print (Library of Congress)
picks.why: color general view of the river front with the Trinity Cathedral and the merchant yard; border and printed captions trimmed

picks.what: Church gate on Troitsky Prospect, photograph (Library of Congress)
picks.why: only usable view for the period; winter street scene on the main avenue; caption and margins trimmed

picks.file: Вид с моста на город - panoramio.jpg
picks.what: The port and city center from the Northern Dvina bridge, photograph
picks.why: only modern skyline view; burned-in date stamp trimmed off

notes: #1 (Leizel, about 1790) is a good early prospect showing the merchant yard (Gostiny Dvor), but it is four thin panorama strips separated by text with a fold down the middle; one strip is too narrow for the card, so it was left out. #2 is a small book wood engraving with some text showing through; the engraver’s signature reads Tollenaar. #7 is the same photochrom as #4 in a lower-resolution crop. LoC’s title for #4 wrongly says Kola Peninsula. #9 is a single street scene, picked only because nothing else covers P5 (#10–#12 are military record cards). #16 is a plain Panoramio snapshot.
